question: A rectangle has integer side lengths and an area of \(2024.\) What is the least possible perimeter of the rectangle?
solution:
The integer side lengths must form a factor pair of \(2024\), so we can compare all possible pairs.

Since \(2024=2^3\cdot11\cdot23\), every divisor is one of \(1,2,4,8\) multiplied by one of \(1,11,23,253\). Also, \(45^2=2025>2024\), so the shorter side is at most \(44\). The possible shorter sides are therefore
\[
1,2,4,8,11,22,23,44.
\]
If the shorter side is \(1,2,4\), or \(8\), the longer side exceeds \(200\), giving a perimeter greater than \(400\). For the remaining possibilities,
\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{Shorter side}&\text{Longer side}&\text{Perimeter}\\
11&184&2(11+184)=390\\
22&92&2(22+92)=228\\
23&88&2(23+88)=222\\
44&46&2(44+46)=180
\end{array}
\]
These cover every factor pair once. Thus the least possible perimeter is \(\boxed{180}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
